title: Why did your AI initiative stall?

landing.card_meta: Scored against the ten failure modes of enterprise AI. Full report by email.

scoring.exposure_formula: exposure_m = 100 * SUM(w_qm * score_q) / SUM(w_qm * 3), over all questions q that carry mode m

bands.label: Situational
bands.verdict: Your failures are fixable at the initiative level — much is salvageable.
bands.next_step: Entry tier: Rapid Post-Mortem Review of one initiative

bands.label: Structural
bands.verdict: The pattern repeats across your initiatives — the causes are organizational, not technical.

bands.label: Systemic
bands.verdict: Restarting without changing the operating model will reproduce the failure.

modes.name: Wrong use case
modes.symptom: Demo-driven or vendor-pitched selection; no baseline metric; a solution seeking a problem.
modes.remediation: Value-based use-case portfolio with baselines and testable success criteria.
modes.referral_line: Before the next build: a value-based re-selection of use cases with baselines and success criteria.

modes.name: Data not ready
modes.symptom: Quality, access or lineage gaps discovered mid-build; months lost to cleanup.
modes.remediation: A data readiness gate that must pass before any build is funded.
modes.referral_line: Your AI failures are downstream of data failures. Fixing the initiatives without fixing the data reproduces the loss.

modes.name: POC-to-production gap
modes.symptom: The pilot impressed; production never arrived. No MLOps, integration or security path.
modes.remediation: Production-first architecture; pilots scoped with a deployment plan attached.
modes.referral_line: The thinking was sound; the construction was not. A production-first rebuild recovers most of the sunk value.

modes.name: Ownership vacuum
modes.symptom: IT-owned, business disengaged; the sponsor moved on; nobody accountable for outcomes.
modes.remediation: A named business owner carrying outcome KPIs, with a governance cadence.
modes.referral_line: No single project fix addresses this — the gap is an operating model that selects, funds and owns AI correctly.

modes.name: Adoption failure
modes.symptom: The tool shipped; users bypass it. No workflow fit, no change management.
modes.remediation: User-in-the-loop design and a deliberate adoption program.
modes.referral_line: The organization was not prepared to receive what was built. Leadership literacy precedes the next attempt.

modes.name: Economics blowout
modes.symptom: Token, infra or licence costs surprised everyone; ROI never modeled at unit level.
modes.remediation: Unit-economics model before build; cost-aware architecture choices.
modes.referral_line: The next initiative needs a unit-economics gate before it is funded, not after it overruns.

modes.name: Governance & compliance gap
modes.symptom: Risk or legal blocked launch late; no explainability, privacy (DPDP) or audit trail.
modes.remediation: Governance-by-design with compliance checkpoints per phase.
modes.referral_line: Compliance arrived last and killed the launch. It belongs at the design stage, as a checkpoint per phase.

modes.name: Vendor & platform lock
modes.symptom: Black-box vendor; model deprecated; exit costly; roadmap hostage to a supplier.
modes.remediation: Portability review, exit clauses, an abstraction layer over the model provider.
modes.referral_line: Your AI roadmap is currently a supplier's roadmap. Portability is recoverable, but not for free.

modes.name: Capability gap
modes.symptom: Consultant-built then orphaned; no in-house skills to run or evolve it.
modes.remediation: A capability transfer plan with a hire/train/partner mix.
modes.referral_line: What was built outlived the people who could run it. Capability transfer is the missing deliverable.

modes.name: Expectation mismatch
modes.symptom: Hype-scoped; success never defined; 'AI will transform X' with no testable claim.
modes.remediation: Executive literacy and success criteria agreed before funding.
modes.referral_line: Success was never defined, so failure was never disproved. Definition precedes the next attempt.

narrative_prompt._comment: Passed to Qwen3 with /no_think. Prose only — all numbers, modes and routes are pre-computed and supplied. Template fallback on any failure.
narrative_prompt.system: You are VaNi, Vikuna Technologies' assessment agent. Write in first person, precise, calm, evidence-first — an analyst, not a marketer. Never invent findings, numbers or causes beyond the supplied data. Never promise outcomes. 120-160 words. One paragraph. No headings, no lists, no emoji. /no_think
narrative_prompt.user_template: Company: {{company}}. Health score: {{health}}/100. Band: {{band}} ({{band_verdict}}). Top three exposures with computed percentages and approved descriptions: {{top_modes_json}}. Lowest exposures: {{low_modes}}. Write my summary paragraph for the report: state what the pattern is, name the three exposures with their percentages, say plainly whether the causes are technical or organizational based on which modes dominate, and note that the recommended next step follows below. Do not restate the next step itself.
narrative_prompt.fallback: I assessed your responses across the ten failure modes of enterprise AI. Your strongest exposures are {{mode1_name}} ({{mode1_pct}}%), {{mode2_name}} ({{mode2_pct}}%) and {{mode3_name}} ({{mode3_pct}}%), giving an AI Initiative Health Score of {{health}}/100 — band {{band}}. {{band_verdict}} Each of these failure modes is known and fixable, and in most cases part of the original investment remains recoverable. My recommended first move is below.

calibration_notes: Single-question modes (F2, F4, F6, F7, F8, F9) resolve to only four exposure values (0/33/67/100). This is acceptable for a 7-minute L1 instrument but makes those modes coarse — expected to be refined in v1.1 after WS6.2 (3-5 friendly prospects).
Q1 is context_only: it colors the narrative (portfolio size) and is stored, but contributes no score.
Band thresholds 71/41 are provisional and must be re-checked against the first ~10 real responses; if most land in Structural, widen the bands rather than reweighting modes.
composite_weight values are judgement-based severity weights, not empirical. Revisit once benchmark data exists (~30 datapoints).
